# The event animations' HD pictures for The Ivalice Chronicles Mod Studio
# ========================================================================
#
# One block of fftpack/event_evtchr_bin.bin (the PlayStation's EVTCHR.BIN)
# per line: `<block>|<g2d.dat entry>`, the HD picture the game draws its
# frames from: the block's own picture at twice the size, colour for colour.
#
# Made by dev/make_evtchr_sheets.py from the game's own files, by comparing
# each block's picture with every picture of the size in system/ffto/g2d.dat.
#
